description: One payer's header: display name and counts, plus its top codes (grouped like the provider RPCs; the filter may name only terms the grouping keeps) and the states it appears in. state narrows only the payer's counts: top_codes stay network-wide. NOT_FOUND when no hospital in the state files the payer. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

filter.description: Keeps only some of the grouped rows (see group_by). Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

group_by.description: How a hospital's rates are grouped (default PAYER_GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION: per billing class + methodology + setting). The filter must name every term the grouping keeps (PAYER_GROUP_BY_ALL with no filter, PAYER_GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS plus a billing_class, PAYER_GROUP_BY_METHODOLOGY plus a methodology, per-combination all three), else INVALID_ARGUMENT.

payer_slug.description: A payer_slug from list_payers or list_code_payers, e.g. "aetna".

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code (e.g. "TX", case-insensitive): only hospitals with a location in that state are counted. A hospital in several states counts in each, so state figures can add up to more than national ones. Empty means every hospital; anything that is not a state code is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT.

top_code_count.description: How many top codes to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 100.
